QuakeCydn

______________________________________________________________________

Page last edited: November 2026.


1. About

QuakeCydn is a fork of QuakeSpasm, a modern version of the Quake engine.

For now not important has changed except a that a bazzy with port part of the engine to c++
  
I used Claude to help port mathlib to C++. I don't have much experience with C and C++, so for now I still rely on tools to help me understand the code. My goal is to rewrite mathlib by hand, without AI, before 2028.

I don't hate AI. But just as some people don't like making pictures with AI because they see drawing as art, I see code as art. I believe hand-written code is the most beautiful, not because it is perfect, but because you can see and feel the programmer in it.
